title: Go: full playability
description: Go definition parses but has zero gameplay tests. Need: stone placement on intersections, capture detection (liberty counting — requires WASM or engine extension), ko rule enforcement, pass-pass game end, territory scoring (WASM required per design). Go captures are the canonical repeat_until_stable perturber use case from DESIGN.md but have never been implemented. Start with basic placement + capture, defer scoring to WASM.
close_reason: Go playable with 29 tests on 9x9 board. Covers: stone placement, flood-fill liberty counting, single/group captures, suicide rule, ko detection (hash comparison), pass/double-pass game end, Chinese-style territory scoring. Game logic implemented as Python GoGame helper (future WASM Tier 2). Full game scenarios including captures + scoring.
